subject: general
question: The Secretary General of the Rajya Saba is appointed by who among the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chairman of Rajya Sabha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The secretary general**, who is also India's Vice President, is chosen by the Rajya Sabha Chairman.
 
• According to the hierarchy of roles, **the cabinet secretary,** the top bureaucrat in the Indian government, has the status of secretary general.
 
• The vice president of India (IAST: Bhrat Ke Uparrapati) is the representative of the head of state of the Republic of India, i.e., **the president of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **vice presidency** is the highest constitutional post following the presidency, coming in second in line of precedence and first in line of succession.
 
• The vice president is a member of the Indian Parliament and acts as the **ex officio chairman** of the Rajya Sabha.
